headline: US stocks hit records as profits keep piling up for Palantir and others, while oil prices ease
summary: The U.S. stock market rallied to records on Tuesday as profits kept piling up for companies and as oil prices eased.  The S&P 500 shot up 1.8%, and the main measure of Wall Street’s health topped its prior all-time high  set a couple months ago.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 907 points, or 1.7%, to its own record set the day before, while the Nasdaq composite jumped 2.6%.
